meta.name: xlsx
meta.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打开、编辑、创建和转换电子表格文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要处理 Excel 或 CSV 文件
copy.tagline_en: Open, edit, create, and convert spreadsheet files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with Excel or CSV files

howto.what: Claude 可以创建、编辑和分析电子表格文件（.xlsx、.csv 等），包括添加公式、格式化、图表、清理数据，并确保公式正确无误。
howto.when: 当用户提到或需要处理电子表格文件（如 .xlsx、.csv），或要求从数据创建表格、转换格式时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开下载文件夹里的销售数据.xlsx，添加一列计算利润。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并添加公式列。

say.text: 把这份 CSV 转成格式漂亮的 xlsx，加上标题和汇总行。
say.note: Claude 会创建新表格并应用格式。

say.text: 修复这个表格里的公式错误，然后重新计算。
say.note: Claude 会检查并修正公式，再运行 recalc。

howto.what_en: Claude can create, edit, and analyze spreadsheet files (.xlsx, .csv, etc.), including adding formulas, formatting, charts, cleaning data, and ensuring formulas are correct.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions or needs to handle a spreadsheet file (e.g., .xlsx, .csv), or asks to create a table from data or convert between formats.

say_en.text: Open the sales data.xlsx in my downloads and add a column to calculate profit.
say_en.note: Claude will read the file and add a formula column.

say_en.text: Convert this CSV to a nicely formatted xlsx with headers and a summary row.
say_en.note: Claude will create a new spreadsheet with formatting.

say_en.text: Fix the formula errors in this spreadsheet and recalculate.
say_en.note: Claude will check and correct formulas, then run recalc.
